verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair axis for an analytics SaaS like Mixpanel, but the evidence pack never documents a user-configurable recurring job, scheduled report, or workflow scheduler. The closest items are warehouse-connector syncs, which only imply periodic data syncs, and a marketing claim that 'Agents monitor your product continuously.' Neither is a user-schedulable job or workflow, so both are adjacent at most and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
